_units: Distances in height units (100 = the screen's height), speeds in units per second, times in seconds. Energy applies to challenge only; zen moves are free.

baseSpeed._about: How fast the ground scrolls in each mood. Zen runs at these times zenMultiplier; challenge starts at these times challengeMultiplier and never goes past cap.

speedIncrease._about: Challenge only, picked in settings. Each loop adds this share of the starting speed, added rather than compounded: loop n runs at start x (1 + gain x (n - 1)), up to baseSpeed.cap.

energyPerMove._about: Jumps and hovers cost the next price in their list each time before you land. A pulse within pulseRepeatWindowSeconds of the last one costs double the last price.

pool._about: Energy starts at start, which is also the lowest the max can go. It refills by refillShareOfMax of the max every second, except while hovering. A hit lowers the max by hitLowersMax.

orbRate._about: Each gap between stone groups gets an orb with chancePerGap, and that orb a neighbour with secondOrbChance. While the sun and moon meet, gaps get eclipseMultiplier tries.

streakBonus._about: every this many orbs in a row without a hit restores this much extra energy, up to the max

jumpStrength._about: A tap peaks around 9 high and a full hold around 24; both scale with jump squared over gravity.

obstacleDistance._about: Seconds between stone groups and between birds, at the current speed. Challenge divides them by (1 + shrinkPerLoop x (n - 1)) each loop, never below minSeconds.
